content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Identify the main structures of the female reproductive system
Describe the functions of each structure
Explain how eggs are produced and released
Describe the structure and function of egg cells

produces eggs (female gametes), receives sperm, provides a site for fertilisation, and supports the development of a baby during pregnancy. Understanding this system is essential for understanding human reproduction.
